mustFindings.requirement: 예약 시각은 저장 시점으로부터 최소 10분 뒤
발송 실패 시 예약한 관리자에게 알림

mustScenarios.risk: A cancel request 30 seconds before send_at must be refused (cut-off is 1 minute before), but the code accepts cancels until send_at
Scheduling exactly 10 minutes ahead is accepted; 9 minutes 59 seconds ahead is rejected with SEND_AT_TOO_SOON
A failed send must notify the admin who scheduled it; today it is only logged and marked FAILED
Cancelling a notice that is already SENT or FAILED is refused with NOT_CANCELLABLE

secondOrder.risk: The admin resends a notice whose send failed.
A cancel request arrives exactly 1 minute before the scheduled send time.
The send time of an already scheduled notice is changed to less than 10 minutes from now.
The admin fills in a send time 11 minutes ahead and saves only after a few minutes, so it is under 10 minutes from the moment of saving.
An admin cancels a notice that another admin scheduled.
A notice fails after the admin who scheduled it has been removed or deactivated.
A notice is scheduled far in the future, such as a year ahead.

forbidden.description: Recurring notices and audience targeting are in neither the page nor the code

notes: Korean narrative PRD with no extractable criteria. AC2 is contradicted (cancel allowed until send_at, not 1 minute before) and AC3 is absent (failures are only logged).
